_comment: The Nexus upload API replaces a version on an EXISTING file, so the first
upload of each variant has to be done by hand on the mod page. After that,
fill in mod_id and each file_id below and the release workflow takes over.
Find the ids on the mod page Files tab with 'Advanced' ticked, or in the
changelog holds the Nexus changelog entries for each version. On release
the workflow posts the entries for the current version, one per line on
the page, and skips any already there, so re-running it is safe. Add the
new version's entries when you bump version.

2.1.0: The controls screen on the System tab now shows the PlayStation or Switch Pro controller layout, with every label pointing at the right button
The small controller picture in the menus matches your controller instead of showing an Xbox pad
